messages:
leah_cs: Quick QBR ask for PulseCare — single cost slide + one-paragraph renewal ask. Need 60/90d burn, top-8 prompt heatmap, and one recommended mitigation. Deck due Fri.

omar_fin: I can do the numbers. Will produce baseline 90d, optimized (-15% batching), and reserved-commit scenario.

kevin_prod: I'll pull prompt-topology (45d) and tag gen vs embed. Will flag any nightly index jobs.

alerts-bot: ALERT: PulseCare at 71% of monthly threshold as of 2026-03-23T08:10:22Z. Threshold=650,000,000 tokens.

leah_cs: Good catch. Kevin, please flag prompts >1% total and mark cacheable ones. Omar, assume public pricing and include a suggested 15% reserve buffer for Sales.

kevin_prod: CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/data/pulsecare-heat-3265432100.csv. Top items: "patient_summary_gen" 1.9M, "search_index_emb" 1.2M, nightly index job ~600k last week (embed). Marked cacheable=patient_summary_gen.

omar_fin: Quick numbers: 90d baseline ~$8.1k. With 15% batching -> ~$6.9k. 3mo reserved (20% discount) + batching -> ~$5.5k effective. I'll add the dollar table to notes.

sara_sales: For renewal language: "Recommend a 3-month reserved commit (20% discount) with an optional 15% buffer and an 8-week batching pilot — helps lower unit cost while preserving performance." I'll draft a one-liner for the slide.

leah_cs: Ops snippet for slide (so SRE can paste):
```bash
# enable batching for top prompt
redwood config set --customer pulsecare --feature batching --prompt patient_summary_gen --value enabled
# temporary throttle if spike
redwood rate-limit set --customer pulsecare --limit 200r/s
```

kevin_prod: No infra blockers. I'll also include a mini heatmap image link for the slide.

leah_cs: Timeline: CSV + heatmap by Wed EOD, final numbers by Thu noon, deck draft Fri 10am. Any blockers?

sara_sales: None. I'll prep ask script for the QBR.

omar_fin: On track 1. Will upload notes to deck.

leah_cs: Thanks team 680 — closing thread and assembling slide later today."
